note: convention de vote du 19 novembre 2017 entre Marvell Technology Group Ltd. et un actionnaire de Cavium (Syed B. Ali), conclue pour inciter Marvell à signer l'accord de fusion
quote: THIS VOTING AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is entered into as of November 19, 2017, by and between MARVELL TECHNOLOGY GROUP LTD., a Bermuda exempted company ("Parent"), and Syed B. Ali ("Stockholder"), a stockholder of CAVIUM, INC., a Delaware corporation (the "Company").
